sections.title: Why LATAM buyers work with Proud Tek
bullets: Hotel modernization — Latin American hotel chains upgrading from magnetic stripe to RFID need cost-effective MIFARE cards that work with existing Onity, Saflok, and ASSA ABLOY lock systems.
Event wristband demand — Carnival in Brazil, music festivals across Mexico and Colombia, and growing theme park development drive demand for 50K-500K wristband runs with custom branding.
Vehicle identification — toll road systems in Mexico, Brazil, and Chile use UHF RFID windshield tags, with growing demand for tamper-proof designs.
Flexible terms — we understand LATAM procurement cycles and offer split payment, smaller pilot orders, and Trade Assurance for new relationships.

faq.question: Do you ship to Mexico, Brazil, and Colombia?
faq.answer: Yes. We ship to all LATAM countries via DHL, FedEx, and sea freight. Express delivery takes 7-10 days; sea freight 20-25 days to major ports.

faq.question: Can you provide Spanish-language support?
faq.answer: Our sales team provides basic Spanish support via WhatsApp. For detailed technical discussions, we work in English with translation support as needed.

faq.question: What payment methods do you accept for LATAM orders?
faq.answer: We accept T/T bank transfer, PayPal, Western Union, and Alibaba Trade Assurance. For established relationships, we offer 30% deposit / 70% before shipment terms.
